text:
Sarah (PM): quick sync — we need a rollout plan for the new region-aware routing flag + tenant opt-in. goal: staged launch with clear QA gates and an automated rollback ladder.

Raj (Eng): sounds good. proposal: staged by region: us-east -> eu-west -> ap-southeast. start with 1% live traffic in first region for 6h, then 5% for 18h, then 25% if stable.

Olivia (Eng-ML): add a shadow A/B for quality checks during the 1% stage. collect responses against our benchmark prompts and run hallucination/accuracy evals. fail if relative degradation > 2pp on any key metric.

Emily (ProdOps): tenant opt-in: expose a per-tenant flag in the console (default off for enterprise). need copy for legal and a migration path for customers who want to opt in early. also require opt-in telemetry: tenant_id + opt_in_label.

Mike (SRE): SLA/latency guardrails: if p95 latency increases > 150ms over baseline for >= 5% of requests in a 15m window, trigger auto-fallback to low-latency variant and page oncall. also circuit-break if error rate > 1% for 10m.

Raj (Eng): flag config sketch:
```json
{
  "flag": "region_routing_v2",
  "stages": [
    {"region": "us-east-1", "pct": 1, "duration": "6h"},
    {"region": "us-east-1", "pct": 5, "duration": "18h"},
    {"region": "us-east-1", "pct": 25, "duration": "24h"},
    {"region": "eu-west-1", "pct": 5, "duration": "24h"},
    {"region": "ap-southeast-1", "pct": 5, "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "fallback": "variant-low-latency",
  "opt_in": "tenant-level"
}
```

Emily (ProdOps): telemetry + dashboards: events: `flag.evaluated`, `flag.fallbacked`, `tenant.opt_in`, `quality.eval_result`. create per-tenant time-series and an aggregate health panel. need retention 90d for rollout window.

Olivia (Eng-ML): evaluation details: run automatic evals every 30m during canary, compare against baseline corpus (S0 prompts). metrics: rouge-like quality, hallucination score, avg tokens per response. threshold: hallucination delta <= 0.5pp, quality delta <= 2pp, token increase <= 10%.

Sarah (PM): launch criteria (must all pass): 1) telemetry healthy for 48h in first two regions (p95, errors, fallback rate). 2) no key eval regression > thresholds. 3) <1% customer support escalations related to quality. 4) sign-off from Eng, SRE, ProdOps.

Mike (SRE): rollback ladder: immediate rollback (tier-0) if error rate >1% or fallback rate >3% for 10m. tier-1 auto-throttle to 10% if latency regressions exceed threshold for 30m and notify owners. tier-2 gradual pause + manual review.

Sarah (PM): operational playbook items: - owner oncall during first 72h - pre-wired runbook link (add to console) - customer comms template for early opt-ins - post-mortem cadence if we hit rollback.

Raj (Eng): deploy snippet for the ops run: `rtr-deploy --flag region_routing_v2 --stage canary --owners @sarah @raj @mike`

deploy-bot: Canary initiated by Raj at 2025-09-12T15:00:00Z. target: us-east-1 1% -> shadow A/B enabled.

Emily (ProdOps): adding checklist to the rollout board and tagging customers who requested early access. will also schedule a 1h watch call for the first 12h.

Olivia (Eng-ML): dropping sample prompts for the eval harness in the thread: link to internal evals (internal link).

Sarah (PM): thanks — next steps: Raj to finalize flag JSON and deploy timeline, Emily to set dashboards and comms, Olivia to hook evals, Mike to wire SLO alerts. ack if you have blockers. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng): ack.

Mike (SRE): ack.

Emily (ProdOps): ack.

Olivia (Eng-ML): ack.

Sarah (PM): marking this thread as the canonical plan for the rollout. will update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
